title: Blob Royale protocol v3 respawn_timer component
description: The committed ticks left before an entity that was knocked out of play is offered a seat again. An entity carrying it has no physics_body; an entity without it is not respawning, so absence is the whole of 'in play' and no member can hold zero on a committed tick.

ticks_remaining.$comment: Ticks, not seconds, because the simulation stores ticks and nothing else on this wire is expressed in seconds. Added in 2.5.
